item.title: About Us
item.description:
🏡 About Sapumal Lodge

We are the Dissanayake family, proud owners of Sapumal Lodge — a small, family-run hotel built with care, run with love, and maintained with pride.

Sapumal Lodge is not just a business, it’s the house we grew up in. Every wall, every room holds memories, and we’ve transformed this beloved family home into a peaceful haven for guests from all over the world.

We are passionate about providing a friendly, family-oriented service. Whether you’re visiting Anuradhapura for its sacred history or a quiet getaway, we want you to feel truly at home.

item.title: Wilpattu Safari
item.description:
🐆 Wilpattu Private Safari

Wilpattu National Park is Sri Lanka’s largest wildlife reserve, renowned for its natural lakes (villus) and incredible biodiversity — including leopards, elephants, and sloth bears.

Just a short drive from Anuradhapura, Wilpattu offers peaceful, scenic safaris through forests and open plains, making it the perfect destination for nature lovers and wildlife photographers.

🛻 What’s Included

  • ✅ Private safari jeep (max comfort, photography-friendly)
  • ✅ Experienced guide/tracker
  • ✅ Entry tickets to Wilpattu National Park
  • ✅ Pickup & drop-off (Anuradhapura and Wilpattu area)
  • ✅ Breakfast pack
  • ✅ Picnic lunch inside the park (vegetarian & local options available)
  • ✅ Drinking water, juice, and snacks
  • ✅ Photo stops and rest breaks

💰 Safari Rates

💵 Prices are per person and include everything listed above.
